posts.text:
Gute Nachrichten! Clean energy has officially overtaken fossil fuels in the third largest economy in the world!

Last year, clean energy outgenerated fossil fuels in Germany for the first time ever with clean energy generating 44% of the total electricity while fossil fuels powered around 43%.
posts.summary: Celebrates clean energy milestone in Germany surpassing fossil fuels
